# Baseline Logistic Regression

This simple historical baseline uses **pre-draft size and position** to predict whether a combine attendee is drafted. It provides an interpretable reference for the expanded Logistic Regression in File 03. The future holdout is not used to select predictors.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
train_data <- readRDS("objects/train_data.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
# The baseline model uses only position, height, and weight.
prelim_model <- glm(Drafted ~ pos_group + InchHeight + wt,
                    data = train_data, family = "binomial")
summary(prelim_model)

# The predicted probability means P(drafted), not an NFL career-success score.
train_data$prelim_probability <- predict(prelim_model, type = "response")
cat("Baseline training-data predicted probabilities:\n")
print(summary(train_data$prelim_probability))

```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(prelim_model, "objects/prelim_model.rds")
```
